messages:
emily_finance: Heads-up  vendor in Germany (Solace GmbH) sent an invoice and marked it 'reverse charge'. They want net payment with no VAT. Can someone confirm we can apply reverse-charge and that their VAT ID is valid?

lucas_ops: Pasted invoice excerpt: ```
Invoice: SOL-2026-998
Vendor: Solace GmbH
VAT ID: DE123456789
Amount: EUR 7,200
Line: Professional services (integration)
Note: "reverse charge - VAT to be accounted by recipient"
```

vatbot: Quick check: please validate VAT ID against VIES and confirm business-to-business (B2B) relationship. Internal link: https://tax-docs.internal/eu-vat-reverse-charge (internal).

nina_procurement: We have a PO and signed SOW with company name matching vendor. They provided a VAT certificate but we haven't validated VIES yet. They asked for payment asap and said their account expects net.

gunnar_eu_tax: Steps: 1) Validate VAT ID on VIES (EU portal). 2) Ensure invoice contains both our VAT ID and theirs or note referencing reverse charge. 3) Confirm supply is B2B and place of supply is Germany/EU rules => recipient accounting in our country applies. If place of supply is outside EU (services provided remotely), different rules may apply.

emily_finance: I ran VIES check quickly, it shows valid (screenshot sent to #private-docs). Our VAT (GB?) is on file as GB987654321. Invoice doesn't show our VAT ID.

gunnar_eu_tax: If our VAT ID isn't on invoice, we should ask vendor to reissue with both VAT IDs and wording: "reverse charge - VAT to be accounted for by the recipient under Article 194 of VAT Directive" (or local equivalent). Also retain evidence of B2B (contract, PO, email).

lucas_ops: Can AP process a temporary hold and pay gross if vendor insists? They said their bank will charge penalties if late.

emily_finance: AP won't pay until invoice meets tax formatting. We can offer net15 as commercial concession but only after corrected invoice. No VAT will be paid by Redwood if reverse-charge applies and invoice validated.

nina_procurement: I'll ask them to reissue with our VAT and the reverse-charge wording. Also requested their company registration docs and a statement that services were supplied to Redwood UK (place of supply).

gunnar_eu_tax: Also capture evidence of VIES validation (date/time) and keep a screenshot. If our country requires additional paperwork for reverse charge, follow local filing steps. For now: do not remit VAT to vendor. Process payment once corrected invoice + VIES evidence received.

emily_finance: Putting AP hold on the invoice and noting required reissue. Emily -> will release once vendor reissues and we upload VIES proof. :white_check_mark:

lucas_ops: Vendor replied within an hour and said they'll reissue with our VAT and the required reverse-charge text. They asked if we can confirm VIES ourselves to speed payment.

emily_finance: Confirmed. After reissue we'll validate and then AP will process. Closing this thread once paid.

vatbot: Reminder: keep invoice + VIES proof for audits (at least 10 years for some jurisdictions).
